description: This Java source file defines a custom Netty AddressResolverGroup that performs SSRF protection by validating resolved IP addresses against a blocklist at connection time. It includes a singleton instance and an inner class implementing address resolution with validation logic.

classes.name: SsrfSafeAddressResolverGroup
classes.description: A singleton class extending AddressResolverGroup that provides SSRF-safe address resolution with validation.

classes.name: SsrfValidatingResolver
classes.description: Inner class implementing AddressResolver with logic to validate resolved addresses against SSRF blocklist.

methods.name: newResolver
methods.description: Creates a new address resolver that wraps the default resolver with SSRF validation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a SocketAddress asynchronously with validation.

methods.name: resolveAll
methods.description: Resolves all addresses for a given SocketAddress with validation.
